title: Reveal
description: x-reveal hides its host until it scrolls into view, then fades it in (x-reveal--visible). Once revealed it stays visible.

threshold.description: How much of the host, from 0 to 1, must be visible before it is revealed.

once.description: Stop watching the host after the first reveal. once="false" keeps watching, which looks the same, because nothing hides the host again.

setup: Fades in when scrolled into view
Fades in when half visible
